content.title: How to watch St. John’s vs. Kansas men’s basketball: Second Round TV channel and streaming options for March 22
content.text: The No. 5 seed St. John’s Red Storm (29-6) take on the No. 4 seed Kansas Jayhawks (24-10) with a Sweet 16 berth on the line on Sunday at Viejas Arena.How to watch St. John’s Red Storm vs. Kansas Jayhawks Venue: Viejas Arena Time: 5:15 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: CBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. St. John’s vs. Kansas odds Spread: St. John’s -3.5 (-110), Kansas +3.5 (-113) Favorite Moneyline: St. John’s -175 Underdog Moneyline: Kansas +142 Total: 145.5 Total Over Odds: -111 Total Under Odds: -111 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know St. John’s averages 81.5 points per game (55th in college basketball) while allowing 69.5 per outing (61st in college basketball). It has a +420 scoring differential overall and outscores opponents by 12.0 points per game. St. John’s knocks down 7.0 three-pointers per game (262nd in college basketball) at a 33.3% rate (213th in college basketball), compared to the 6.2 its opponents make while shooting 31.1% from deep. Kansas’ +214 scoring differential (outscoring opponents by 6.3 points per game) is a result of putting up 75.4 points per game (183rd in college basketball) while giving up 69.1 per outing (56th in college basketball). Kansas makes 7.3 three-pointers per game (226th in college basketball) at a 34.6% rate (151st in college basketball), compared to the 8.0 its opponents make, shooting 30.5% from deep.
